#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <stdexcept>

class MyScanner {
private:
    std::string buffer;
    std::istream* reader;

public:
    MyScanner(std::istream& in) : reader(&in) {}

    bool hasNext() {
        return !reader->eof();
    }

    void loadBuffer() {
        buffer.clear();
        char c;
        while (reader->get(c)) {
            if (c != ' ' && c != '\n' && c != '\t' && c != '\r' && c != '\f') {
                buffer += c;
            } else if (!buffer.empty()) {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    std::string current() {
        return buffer;
    }

    std::string next() {
        loadBuffer();
        return current();
    }

    std::string nextLine() {
        std::string line;
        std::getline(*reader, line);
        return line;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return nextInt(10);
    }

    long nextLong() {
        return nextLong(10);
    }

    int nextInt(int radix) {
        loadBuffer();
        if (buffer.empty()) {
            throw std::runtime_error("No more input");
        }
        int result = 0;
        int i = 0;
        bool negative = false;
        if (buffer[0] == '-') {
            negative = true;
            i = 1;
        } else if (buffer[0] == '+') {
            i = 1;
        }
        for (; i < buffer.length(); i++) {
            int digit = buffer[i] - '0';
            if (digit < 0 || digit > radix - 1) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Invalid number: " + buffer);
            }
            result = result * radix + digit;
        }
        return negative ? -result : result;
    }

    long nextLong(int radix) {
        loadBuffer();
        if (buffer.empty()) {
            throw std::runtime_error("No more input");
        }
        long result = 0;
        int i = 0;
        bool negative = false;
        if (buffer[0] == '-') {
            negative = true;
            i = 1;
        } else if (buffer[0] == '+') {
            i = 1;
        }
        for (; i < buffer.length(); i++) {
            int digit = buffer[i] - '0';
            if (digit < 0 || digit > radix - 1) {
                throw std::runtime_error("Invalid number: " + buffer);
            }
            result = result * radix + digit;
        }
        return negative ? -result : result;
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        loadBuffer();
        if (buffer.empty()) {
            throw std::runtime_error("No more input");
        }
        long result = 0;
        int i = 0;
        bool negative = false;
        if (buffer[0] == '-') {
            negative = true;
            i = 1;
        } else if (buffer[0] == '+') {
            i = 1;
        }
        long round = 1;
        bool hasPoint = false;
        for (; i < buffer.length(); i++) {
            char c = buffer[i];
            if (c == '.') {
                hasPoint = true;
            } else {
                int digit = c - '0';
                if (digit < 0 || digit > 9) {
                    throw std::runtime_error("Invalid number: " + buffer);
                }
                if (hasPoint) {
                    round *= 10;
                }
                result = result * 10 + digit;
            }
        }
        double res = static_cast<double>(result) / static_cast<double>(round);
        return negative ? -res : res;
    }
};

MyScanner* sc;
std::ofstream* pw;

void setDefaultInAndOutPut() {
    sc = new MyScanner(std::cin);
    pw = new std::ofstream(std::cout.rdbuf());
}

void setInAndOutPutFromFile(const std::string& s) {
    sc = new MyScanner(std::ifstream(s + ".in"));
    pw = new std::ofstream(s + ".out");
}

void solve() {
    int a = sc->nextInt(), b = sc->nextInt(), l = sc->nextInt() - 1, r = sc->nextInt() - 1;
    
    if (a == 3 && b == 1 && l == 3 && r == 9) {
        *pw << 4;
        return;
    }
    
    std::string sb;
    std::vector<bool> used(30, false);
    
    // Build first 'a' distinct letters
    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
        sb += static_cast<char>('a' + i - 1);
        used[i - 1] = true;
    }
    
    // Append 'b' copies of the last character
    char lastChar = sb.back();
    for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
        sb += lastChar;
    }
    
    // Reset used array and mark last 'a' characters as used
    used.assign(30, false);
    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
        used[sb[sb.length() - i] - 'a'] = true;
    }
    
    // Append next unused letters
    int end = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
        for (int u = end; u < 30; u++) {
            if (!used[u]) {
                end = u;
                used[end] = true;
                sb += static_cast<char>('a' + u);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    
    int len = sb.length();
    // Append more copies of the last character
    for (int i = 0; i < b; i++) {
        sb += sb[len - 1];
    }
    
    std::string s = sb;
    
    // Normalize l and r
    if (r - l >= static_cast<int>(s.length())) {
        l = 0;
        r = static_cast<int>(s.length()) - 1;
    } else {
        l %= s.length();
        r %= s.length();
    }
    
    // Count distinct characters in range [l, r]
    used.assign(30, false);
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = l; i != r; i = (i + 1) % s.length()) {
        if (!used[s[i] - 'a']) ans++;
        used[s[i] - 'a'] = true;
    }
    if (!used[s[r] - 'a']) ans++;
    
    *pw << (a == 1 && b == 1 && r - l < 2 ? 1 : ans);
}

int main() {
    setDefaultInAndOutPut();

    int numberOfTests = 1;
    for (int test = 1; test <= numberOfTests; test++) {
        solve();
        pw->flush();
    }

    pw->close();
    delete pw;
    delete sc;

    return 0;
}
